title: Shinichi Kudo's Aquarium Case
notes: Told as a Shinichi-narrated flashback before he became Conan. Recurring-cast nodes omitted by convention (same rule as ep011): Shinichi Kudo, Ran Mouri, Kogoro Mouri, Eri Kisaki, Sonoko Suzuki, Dr. Agasa, and Inspector Megure all appear but never touch the mystery's evidence graph beyond framing the aquarium-visit subplot. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old cases/ file's culprit (Naho Ojiro) is confirmed correct against the transcript -- no discrepancy there -- but it collapsed the cast to a bare suspect/victim/witness list with generic `knows` edges and 3 event nodes; this rebuild adds the two named witnesses' full roles (Kanoko Nakagiri as the victim's actual date that day, Kodai Jinbe as Naho's unwitting current boyfriend whose cap hid her phone), the blackmail motive object, sub-locations (cafe, dolphin tank, underwater tunnel) instead of one generic aquarium location, and decomposes the two comparative clues plus a third (handedness contradiction) that the old file's c2 only partially captured. Transcript romanizes the victim's name 'Kunihiro Shumoto' throughout (one stray 'Kunihito' typo in the raw subtitle at 00:22:04 of part 1); kept 'Kunihiro' as canonical, matching the old file. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Naho's video is vertical and nobody in frame avoids the cameraman, unlike Jinbe's genuine sideways shark video where bystanders visibly step around him -- proves her phone was hidden, not held.
The glove in an earlier photo of Naho with Jinbe is a different color than the one she wore later that day, and the true (hidden) side of that later glove has the victim's blood on the fingertips.

In Jinbe's genuine video Naho works her phone left-handed while wearing knitted gloves, but she demonstrably favors her right hand elsewhere -- a smartphone needs a bare hand, so she must have swapped her right glove out to commit the murder.
The cafe receipt lists a dolphin keychain bought alongside the drinks, but none was found on the victim -- he must have given it to his dolphin-loving date.

edges.detail: threatened to send indecent photos of her to her boyfriend, workplace, and family unless paid, citing his own debt

edges.method: pressed stun gun to the nape of his neck while he leaned over a tank rim
stabbed through the heart with a knife hidden in a convenience-store bag
